AUTHENTICATED PORTAL / WORKSPACE ACCESS
Admin: accounts and maintenance. Staff: descriptive records, intake, investigation and proposals.
Manager: operations, setup, correction decisions and rent confirmation. Tenant: own bills, rent reports, receipts and personal utility marks.
